topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Imagine my surprise when I opened that link and there it was—my college application essay, live and open for the world to read. At first, a rush of surprise, maybe a hint of concern. But then, a warm sense of pride took over. It’s a strange thing, seeing your words chosen, your story deemed worth sharing. It made me appreciate the journey more, the late nights, the edits, the moments of doubt. I'm glad, though, that someone saw something in it that they thought could help others. It's a nice reminder that our efforts can ripple out in unexpected, beautiful ways. Maybe, just maybe, it'll inspire someone else to share their own story, however flawed or extraordinary it might be.
